text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"Air-raid sirens are sounding in Kathivakkam, indicating an imminent threat of aerial attack.","main_move":"STAY_INSIDE_AWAY_FROM_WINDOWS","main_move_text":"Move immediately to an interior room or hallway on the ground floor, staying away from windows and exterior walls.","where_to_go":"Stay where you are in Kathivakkam and seek an interior windowless room or basement.","do_now":[{"text":"Move to a central, windowless room, hallway, or under concrete stairs on the ground floor.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_COVER_01"]},{"text":"Close all windows, blinds, and exterior doors to reduce blast and fragment hazards.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_SEAL_01"]},{"text":"Lie face down on the ground and cover your head and neck with your arms if an blast occurs.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_PROTECT_01"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not look out windows or stand near glass or exterior walls during sirens or explosions.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_GLASS_01"]},{"text":"Do not go outside or attempt to drive during an active air-raid alert.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_OUTSIDE_01"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"In a high-rise building","text":"Move down to the lower or basement levels using stairs, avoiding elevators.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_HIGHRISE_01"]}],"call":["112","100"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Standard emergency response protocol for active city-wide air-raid alerts.","unknowns":["Exact duration of the alert","Specific targets or incoming vectors"],"valid_while":["Until an official all-clear signal is announced by authorities"]}
